title: Curved Knowledge in Flat Models: Building Expert AI at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2607.17513v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Intelligence that must act before outside correction arrives must carry the structure of its expert knowledge, and hyperbolic geometry represents hierarchy with a fidelity no Euclidean space of comparable dimension matches. Yet hyperbolic language models confine that geometry to adapters or rebuild the transformer, and an independent audit of released hyperbolic vision language checkpoints finds their hierarchy mechanisms inactive, which has been read as evidence about the geometry or its objective. Here we show that it is also evidence about arithmetic. The constraint defining the manifold is a difference of two terms that grow together; for the unclamped map at unit curvature and temperature it fails in every format we measured, double precision included, at the deep-layer norms of the language models measured here, beyond the limit previously derived. translated_title: 平直模型中的弯曲知识：规模化构建专家级人工智能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.17513v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：必须在外部纠偏到来之前就采取行动的智能，必须承载其专家知识的内在结构，而双曲几何以任何同等维度的欧氏空间都无法企及的保真度来表示层级结构。然而，现有的双曲语言模型要么将该几何仅局限于适配器模块中，要么重新构建整个Transformer；同时，一项针对已发布的双曲视觉-语言模型检查点的独立审计发现其层级机制处于失活状态，这曾被解读为关于该几何表示本身或其训练目标存在问题的证据。本文证明，这实际上也是关于数值算术的证据。定义流形的约束是两个同步增长项之差；对于在单位曲率与温度下未加钳制的映射，在我们测量的所有数值格式中（包括双精度浮点数），该约束在本文所测语言模型的深层网络范数处均告失效，超出了此前推导出的极限。一种常见的补救措施——范数上界——会使所执行的映射失去径向敏感性……
tldr: 本文揭示已发布双曲视觉-语言模型层级机制失效的真正根源是数值算术问题而非几何设计——定义双曲流形的约束在深层网络范数下即使双精度浮点也无法满足，而常用的范数约束补救措施又会使映射丧失径向敏感性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the inactive hierarchy mechanisms in released hyperbolic vision-language models stem from numerical arithmetic rather than geometry or objectives—the manifold's defining constraint fails at deep-layer norms even in double precision, and the common norm-bound remedy strips the executed map of radial sensitivity.
